revision_summary: One quote timestamp error to fix: in script_coverage (appointment_set section), the customer_quote 'Yeah. Six Wednesday is fine.' is tagged at ts 00:47, but 00:47 is actually the rep's line ('Are you available this coming Tuesday or Wednesday?'). The customer's acceptance quote actually occurs at 01:27. Correct the ts field to 01:27 (or restructure so the 00:47 ts only carries the rep's opening question and the customer's acceptance gets its own correct ts). Additionally, on rerun: (1) tighten cherry_pick_moments[1]'s schema_reference from the narrow 'button_up.is_that_fair_handshake' to the broader button_up section since the stewart_read discusses multiple missing sub-elements, not just the handshake; (2) clarify the outcome_dispute framing in trajectory_verdict so it doesn't simultaneously claim the v1 tag is 'unknown' and frame the entry as a dispute against it — either state plainly there's no v1 tag to compare against and this is an independent completeness observation, or drop the 'dispute' framing; (3) optionally note the odd screening/gatekeeper opening at 00:00–00:26 in starting_state context, since the live conversation with Brian doesn't truly begin until 00:26. These are minor-to-moderate fixes; the core trajectory read (thin reschedule booking, no verify/bill/interest work, missing button-up) is well-supported and should be preserved.
